verification.rationale: Machine-derived from plain CadQuery and OCP. A human must review the entities and incidence against the program text before this record gates a release.

program.text:
import cadquery as cq

wp = cq.Workplane("XY")
box = wp.box(10, 20, 5)
rot = box.rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 0.1)
top = rot.faces(">Z")
plane = top.workplane()
hole = plane.circle(2)
result = hole.cutBlind(-2)

excluded.reason: intermediate states are outside schema_version 1 final-state scope
profiles, paths, workplanes and selector results are outside schema_version 1 incidence scope
uses, derived_from, selected_from and selected_by need 02a and 02b records; added when those stages land
effect measurements need 02b effect capture; added when that stage lands
point probes are outside schema_version 1 final-state topology scope
pair relations and has_point_probe are outside schema_version 1 scope
pair measurements and point-probe measurements are outside schema_version 1 scope

notes: Descriptors resolve by equality; a descriptor that matches zero or several entities is a record defect.
